release_notes: FIX: admin 'Login as User' (/admin/account/show -> login-as) was landing on the reseller/master account instead of the intended client. Root cause: UserController::loadUser() had a loose fallback to $hostings[0] (the master 'planethosts' reseller account) whenever the sudo session id didn't match by id/email/name — exactly the 'logs into their reseller account not their client account' symptom. Fix: loginAs now stores the exact sudo_login_user_id, loadUser() resolves that id FIRST (and the unsafe $hostings[0] fallback was removed), and exitSudo clears the new keys. Verified live: login-as planethosts -> 'Welcome back, Jamie', suggawayz -> Edward, testacct -> Test — each lands on the correct client dashboard.
